_comment: Source of truth for Fabric item-definition part requirements. Powers `fabio item validate-definition`, definition-authoring error hints, and `fabio context schema`. Canonical part paths are what `getDefinition`/Git-integration export return (and what deploy round-trips). The Fabric updateDefinition API is often LENIENT and tolerates alias filenames, so the offline validator flags a missing canonical part as a WARNING (not an error) unless --strict. Universal envelope rules (parts array, path/payload/payloadType, base64, JSON validity) are always errors. Verified live against the tenant where marked.

Notebook.note: Source part is notebook-content.py with `# CELL ***` markers (format 'ipynb'), or a raw notebook-content.ipynb. Add notebook-settings.json (since Mar 2026) for auto-binding lakehouse dependencies. Verified live.

DataPipeline.note: pipeline-content.json = {"properties":{"activities":[...]}}. Empty pipeline is {"properties":{"activities":[]}}. Verified live.

CopyJob.note: Canonical export part is copyjob-content.json = {"properties":{"jobMode":"Batch"},"activities":[]}. The API also accepts the alias CopyJobV1.json. Verified live.

Dataflow.note: Canonical export parts are queryMetadata.json (settings) + mashup.pq (the Power Query M script). The API also tolerates a single dataflow.json part. Verified live.

SparkJobDefinition.note: The part FILENAME is SparkJobDefinitionV1.json; the definitionFormat is SparkJobDefinitionV2 — do NOT confuse them. Content = {"executableFile","defaultLakehouseArtifactId","mainClass","additionalLakehouseIds":[],"commandLineArguments","additionalLibraryUris","language","environmentArtifactId"}. Verified live.

Report.note: definition.pbir binds the report to a semantic model (byConnection XOR byPath). report.json = PBIR-Legacy (v1.0); a definition/ folder = PBIR enhanced (v4.0+). Validate offline first: fabio report validate --source <folder>.

PaginatedReport.note: The single RDL part path MUST equal '<displayName>.rdl' or the API returns MissingDefinitionParts. The definition object must NOT include a 'format' field (sending format:PaginatedReportDefinition is rejected with InvalidDefinitionFormat).

SemanticModel.note: definition.pbism declares the format. model.bim = TMSL (v1.0); a definition/ folder of *.tmdl = TMDL (v4.0+). Compat level 1604 for Direct Lake.

VariableLibrary.note: variables.json (definitions) + settings.json (required). Alternate value sets live under valueSets/<name>.json using variableOverrides. Active set is a workspace setting, not part of the definition.

Eventstream.note: eventstream.json holds the streaming topology (sources, destinations, operators). Validate offline: fabio eventstream validate.

Reflex.note: ReflexEntities.json defines entities and rule actions (Data Activator). KQL sources cannot be configured via REST — use the portal.

KQLDashboard.note: RealTimeDashboard.json holds tiles, data sources (clusterUri + database), and KQL queries per tile.

KQLQueryset.note: RealTimeQueryset.json (NOT RawQueryset.kql): {"queryset":{"version","dataSources":[{"id","clusterUri","type","databaseName"}],"tabs":[{"id","content","title","dataSourceId"}]}}. tab.content is the KQL text (\n for newlines).

Map.note: map.json holds the geospatial map definition. Structure (schema map/definition/2.0.0): {"$schema", "basemap":{...}, "dataSources":[{itemType, workspaceId, itemId}], "layerSources":[{id, name, type, itemId?, relativePath?, refreshIntervalMs?, options?}], "layerSettings":[{id, name, sourceId, latitudeColumnName?, longitudeColumnName?, geometryColumnName?}], "iconSources":[]}. CRUD + get/update-definition are fully authorable over REST (a fresh map has empty layer arrays; basemap/layer edits persist). BUT the per-layer 'type' + 'options' values are NOT enumerated in the published schema — they are generated by the portal 'Add data / Show on map' wizard (eventhouse KQL function layer with lat/long geometry, GeoJSON file layer, data-driven styling), so authoring a working data LAYER requires reverse-engineering a portal-created map. The KQL function that feeds a layer is CLI-authorable via kql-database query (.create-or-alter function).

Plan.note: Format is PlanV1. connectedPlanning/infobridge.json is the canonical part path observed in the Fabric REST API spec examples; definition is optional on create (omit for an empty plan).

GraphModel.note: A graph model definition is FIVE JSON parts (NOT a single GraphModel.json), each with a $schema under .../item/graphIndex/definition/. (1) graphType.json = the schema: nodeTypes[{alias, labels[], primaryKeyProperties[], properties[{name,type}]}] and edgeTypes[{alias, labels[], sourceNodeType:{alias}, destinationNodeType:{alias}, properties?[]}]; property type is one of STRING/INT/UINT/BOOL/DOUBLE (temporal not supported). (2) dataSources.json = dataSources[{name, type:'DeltaTable', properties:{path:'abfss://<ws>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<lakehouseId>/Tables/<table>'}}]. (3) graphDefinition.json = nodeTables[{nodeTypeAlias, id:<guid>, dataSourceName, propertyMappings[{propertyName, sourceColumn}]}] and edgeTables[{edgeTypeAlias, id:<guid>, dataSourceName, sourceNodeKeyColumns[], destinationNodeKeyColumns[], propertyMappings?[]}]. (4) stylingConfiguration.json and (5) graphSettings.json are portal visual/settings state. alias = numeric-string InternalIdentifier; id = GUID. Author via update-definition (the API accepts a schema-valid definition), but the graph LOAD/refresh is PORTAL-GATED: a REST-created graph must be initialized once in the Fabric portal (provisions internal loading infra) before refresh-graph/GQL query work — see fabio graph-model initialize.

OperationsAgent.note: Configurations.json holds the RTI operations agent config. The top-level shouldRun boolean activates it (Fabric coerces it back to false unless a data source + playbook are configured).

AnomalyDetector.note: Configurations.json holds the anomaly detector configuration: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "univariateConfigurations":[...]}. A fresh detector starts with an empty univariateConfigurations array. The per-entry config (value-to-watch column, group-by columns, timestamp column, detection model) is authored in the Fabric portal's 'Detect anomalies' flow — its schema is NOT published (a hand-crafted entry is rejected server-side with InternalError), and the 'Analyze my data' model-recommendation + results are portal/compute-only. CRUD + get/update-definition (empty/round-trip) work over REST.

MountedDataFactory.note: mountedDataFactory-content.json references the mounted Azure Data Factory.

Environment.note: environment.metadata.json holds Spark compute + libraries. Publish staging after update: fabio environment publish.

MirroredDatabase.note: mirroring.json holds the source connection + replication config.

MirroredAzureDatabricksCatalog.note: mirroring.json holds the Azure Databricks (Unity Catalog) mirroring config.

GraphQLApi.note: graphql-definition.json (bindings) and/or schema.graphql (the GraphQL SDL). fabio graphql-api update-definition sends a single schema.graphql part.

Ontology.note: definition.json is the root; entity/relationship types and data bindings live in per-object subfolders. Untyped properties must NEVER appear in a DataBinding's propertyBindings.

SnowflakeDatabase.note: definition.json holds the Snowflake mirroring/source config.

UserDataFunction.note: definition.json holds the function metadata. Invoke a PUBLISHED function via its portal URL: fabio user-data-function invoke --url <url>.

CosmosDbDatabase.note: definition.json holds the Cosmos DB (NoSQL) database config.

DigitalTwinBuilder.note: definition.json holds the Digital Twin Builder model.

DigitalTwinBuilderFlow.note: definition.json holds the Digital Twin Builder flow.
